title: validate-request
description: POST /api/v1/licence/validate body - the daily check-in. Per-till licensing (section 17.15): EVERY till with a portal licence sends it for itself (installId + installCode identify it; registers[] may be absent). Branch model (17.5): the main till, listing registers[].

approverKids.description: Built-in kids whose signer certificates this till accepts (docs/web-portal-api.md 17.17). Sign a returned token with a kid in trustedKids, or with your certified key when its certificate approvedBy is in this list.

clockWatermarkUtc.description: The latest time this till has ever seen (its clock guard).

reason.description: Why the till is locked, null when not locked. Known values: trialOver, expired, revoked, suspended, offlineTooLong, clockTampering, seatsExceeded. Treat an unknown value as described in docs/web-portal-api.md section 17.11.

diagnostics.description: Open object for support, e.g. pendingSyncRows, lastSyncError, databaseSizeMb. Store as-is; never required.
